name: Chang 2025 Positively Charged Trastuzumab-vc-MMAE ADC Mouse PK/PD
description: Reduced empirical ODE and exact endpoint replay model for Chang et al. 2025, which compared wild-type trastuzumab-vc-MMAE ADC with a +5 positively charged variant in mouse plasma, NCI-N87 and MCF-7 tumors, liver, spleen, and N87 efficacy studies. The article reports WinNonlin NCA summaries rather than a mechanistic structural PK/PD ODE; this implementation preserves every public Table 1-6 scalar as exact anchors and provides first-order exposure ODE scenarios calibrated to reported Cmax/AUC endpoints for paper-overlay validation.
